title: Tracing the Data Trail: A Survey of Data Provenance, Transparency and Traceability in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying methods from NLP and Explainable AI that calculate a gender bias score based on the common co-occurrence of gendered nouns and pronouns in close textual proximity.
Surveying approaches that use LLM-generated categorization to avoid and mitigate human-induced biases found in hand-labeled datasets (e.g., spam message classification).
Reviewing literature on how inherent biases in historical internet data are adopted, propagated, and amplified by LLMs through synthetic data feedback loops and unregulated training.
